nuggets.text: Saturday at Vanderbilt is the Blue Hens' first game ever against an SEC opponent.
The Blue Hens are 18-29-4 against Power 4 teams, and 17 of those wins came against Maryland and Rutgers.
Ryan Carty was a Delaware quarterback who lost the starting job to future Super Bowl MVP Joe Flacco.
Ryan Carty began his coaching career at New Hampshire under Chip Kelly.
Viron Ellison Jr. ran for a touchdown and threw a 75-yard touchdown pass on a trick play against Merrimack.
Nick Minicucci's first college start came in a 2023 FCS playoff game, a 36-34 Blue Hens win over Lafayette.
The Blue Hens won their first FBS bowl game last December, beating Louisiana 20-13 in the 68 Ventures Bowl.
The Blue Hen name dates to the Revolutionary War, when Delaware soldiers were called the Blue Hens' Chickens.
The YoUDee mascot team won eight national championships between 2002 and 2019 and is in the Mascot Hall of Fame.
The Blue Hens have won eight straight season openers.
